## Description

Synthetic availability probes per country (sign-in, booking read, portal home), SLO dashboard and error budget, monthly availability calculation published on the status page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Probes run every minute from in-country locations; availability computed per month.
- [ ] **AC2.** 30 consecutive days ≥ 99.5 % before week 32 (exit gate 4) or the GA date moves.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
